evidence.method: transform restated from the regular 1-D coordinates; CRS restated from the source
evidence.crs_from: the source COGs (ausantarctic/ibcso/annual-2025/cog/<array>.tif) declare EPSG:9354 (WGS 84 / IBCSO Polar Stereographic), origin -4800000, 4800000, cell 500 m, 19200 x 19200, AREA_OR_POINT=Area (gdal.Open on each COG, GDAL 3.13.3, PROJ 9.9.0, 2026-11-28). py/ibcso_cog.py keeps the CRS of the release GeoTIFFs (IBCSO 2025 annual release, from ibcso.org)
evidence.note: the release's own GeoTIFF for this grid states an origin of -4800018.55, 4800018.55, 18.55 m off the v2 grid that the release's rid and tid grids use; the COG takes the v2 origin with pixels unchanged (py/ibcso_cog.py, GEOTRANSFORM_CORRECTED tag in the COG).
